title: Two cards taken without choosing either
era: 1995 Worlds Standard using contemporary card pool and current resolution
story: I tapped two Swamp s during my main phase and cast Hymn to Tourach at my opponent, who had three cards in hand. They shuffled the cards face down, and two were selected at random for discard. I had not chosen their strongest spells, and the remaining card was not automatically the worst. The Rack was already on my battlefield, ready to punish a small hand on a later trigger. Hymn left one card in their hand and none in exile. I watched the discarded cards go to the graveyard and knew that random was the entire point of the spell.
review: Two Swamps produce BB, sorcery on caster main phase, three cards opponent hand, two random discard leaving one, no chosen-target-cards or library mill. Rack remains a separate upkeep trigger.
